run_compressor_evaluation: run the compressor evaluation script with a specified compressor and dataset via CLI flags
evaluate_compressor_chunked: evaluate a compressor on chunked data and return compression rate and running time
evaluate_compressor_unchunked: evaluate a compressor on unchunked data and return compression rate and running time
test_classical_compressor: test a classical compressor like gzip on enwik9 dataset with chunked and unchunked evaluation
test_arithmetic_coding_compressor: test an arithmetic coding compressor with ASCII masking on enwik9 dataset
